faqs.e: Only Delhi, Puducherry, and Jammu & Kashmir have representation; the other five union territories have populations too small for any representative.

faqs.e: The oath sworn as a qualification for being chosen a member (before the election commission's authorised person) covers only these two points; the duty-related clause belongs to the separate oath taken before actually entering the House.

faqs.e: In computing this period, no account is taken of any period during which the House is prorogued or adjourned for more than four consecutive days.

faqs.q: If a disqualified candidate is elected to Parliament, which authority can declare the election void?
faqs.e: This is enabled by the Representation of the People Act, 1951; the aggrieved party can appeal to the Supreme Court against the High Court's order.

faqs.e: The three sessions are the Budget Session (February to May), the Monsoon Session (July to September), and the Winter Session (November to December).
